facts.text: Žije často v blízkosti lidí, na zdech a plotech i uvnitř domů.
facts.quote: The species is often associated with people, being found on walls and fences and sometimes inside houses.

facts.text: Mimo lidská obydlí se vyskytuje pod kameny a na kmenech stromů.
facts.quote: Away from dwellings, it is also found under stones and on tree trunks.
